text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
 I1, which must be 
 performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title 
 block
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal 
 Assy, tested 
 by eng. Mohamed Hussein Sherif, accepted by general manager eng Mohamed Kamel 
 Afify and approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power 
 station & MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
The unit must be stopped.
Isolate the air fan mechanically & 
 electrically
Stopped the A.P.H motor
Isolate the berg steam and all 
 valves (delivery & suction)
Open the drains
Tools 
and Equipment
Workshop kit 
 (spanners & wrenches)
Screw drivers & gear pullers ... 
 etc
Lubricating oil & general purpose 
 grease
Power supply panel
Hoisting
Spanner & wrenches
Graphite packing
Allen keys
Mobil extra heavy oil about (25) 
 lit
Work to be 
carried out
Operate to check the performance
Define the troubles
Disassemble the defective units
Remove insulation
Check external body and flexible joint
Check the valves of soot blowers
Check the soot blowers (pipe, body, chain & packing)
Check the cooling water system
Check the heating system piping
Check the bearing (upper & lower)
Check the oil
Check the driving gear of gas air preheater
Check the gears of driven groups
Check the pumps, oil tank, oil level & filters for hydraulic driven groups
Check the heating element basket (cool & hot sides)
Check the clearance
Assemble the element
Adjust the driven groups
Check the running after repairing
Restore all valves to the operating normal position
Clean the area after repairing
